summary_zh:
這裡是冰島斯奈山半島重要的漁港，這裡有幾個重要的景觀。 【Músagjá】心型海蝕洞，以及漂亮的拱橋，從停車場往西走到「Arnarstapi Harbour」，單趟約 20-30 分鐘，很值得一來，可以欣賞海岸的美景。

付費廁所在旁邊。
summary_en: This important fishing harbor on Iceland’s Snæfellsnes Peninsula features several notable sights, including the heart‑shaped sea cave Músagjá and a beautiful arch bridge. From the free parking lot, walk west toward Arnarstapi Harbour; the one‑way route takes about 20–30 minutes and is well worth it for the coastal scenery. A paid restroom is located nearby. Allocate around 90 minutes to explore the area.
